name: Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai vol.2
original_name: ゾンビのあふれた世界で俺だけが襲われない vol.2
source:
Yuusuke and Mitsuki rush to the city hall to have the municipal survivor group save Mitsuki's wounded brother. Mitsuki meets her childhood friend who proceeds to takes over Yuusuke's guardian role for Mitsuki. Yuusuke will have to decide either to stay and wait for the evacuation or not.

Based on the popular web novel of the same title. The story covers the first half of volume 3 (Chapter 32 "Wakare" to Chapter 44 "Ibasho." of the web novel).
translation:
雄介和深月赶往市政厅，请市政府幸存者团体救助深月受伤的弟弟。深月遇见青梅竹马，对方接替雄介，成为深月的保护者。雄介必须决定，是留下等待撤离，还是选择离开。

改编自同名人气网络小说。本作涵盖网络小说第三卷前半部分（第32章“分别”至第44章“归处”）。
